entries.title: Første commit
entries.alt: Gitmejsen ser på en kladde og en færdig skitse af den samme redekasse. Den færdige skitse er mærket med et gyldent frø.
entries.prompt: Make one 3:2 landscape teaching story illustration for ages 15+ (no graphic overlays and no words). Use reference image as the exact identity of the original female crested tit teacher. Preserve her tall tapered black-speckled cream feather crest, curved dark cheek marking, cream belly, small dark bib and short pointed bill, taupe wings, gentle expressive amber-brown eyes, two natural bird feet, and her one signature woven cobalt-blue scarf with exactly two short ends at its knot. She is a proper bird throughout with two wings, two tiny clawed feet, no hands, no human arms or additional limbs. Same softly sculpted matte, tactile, subtly stylized Nordic 3D stop-motion storybook render, natural scale, warm materials. No logos, text, labels, signatures or fake typography. Show the bird as the keeper of a little spruce-wood workbench in her quiet Finnish treehouse. On the workbench are a clearly unfinished, hand-drawn simple birdhouse sketch on a sheet of light paper and beside it a single neat final birdhouse sketch on new ivory archival paper, with a tiny golden seed-shaped seal, suggesting the first saved version. An elegant small empty clip and a dark blue pencil sit nearby. Bird on left perches with two feet on edge of table and looks towards final sketch. Artful storybook realism, clean composition, readable two separate versions, wood grain and warm afternoon light. No apparent writing or lettering anywhere, only abstract birdhouse outlines and no human hands.
